obligations.name: reactor_channel_membership
obligations.description: Select the single channel_members record for the user who reacted with 'eyes' on the circuit-tracer OOM message in the engineering channel, and report when they joined that channel.

task_spec.text: Identify who reacted with 👀 to the circuit-tracer OOM message in the engineering channel and report when that person joined the engineering channel.

access_plan: Locate the engineering channel (#engineering) via conversations.list/users.conversations, use conversations.history or search.messages to find the message text about circuit-tracer OOM errors, call reactions.get on that message to find the 'eyes' reactor, then use conversations.members (or the channel_members join-time data surfaced via conversations.info) to read that user's joined_at in the engineering channel.
